packages/greenfield traceability invariant: every stage-to-stage handoff is a typed spine trace link (candidate SATISFIES mission; candidate COMPOSES members; decision SUPPORTS candidate; ask DERIVED_FROM the originating decision; resolution SUPPORTS candidate; systemState REALIZES candidate and its declared architecture; implModel IMPLEMENTS the declared architecture; reconciliation finding links; evidence OBSERVES the system state) and the full result is ONE connected semantic subgraph from Mission to SystemState — machine-checked at every stage boundary (requireLink) AND over the final result (assertTraceChainComplete: every artifact linked + in the Mission's connected component + the directed SystemState->candidate->Mission traceability path walkable); a missing link fails the pipeline

packages/greenfield identity discipline: every artifact identity is minted by the spine (content-addressed); the one documented exception is the DECLARED ArchitectureGraph hypothesis, whose id is content-addressed over its DECLARATION address (mission + candidate + declared shape + run provenance) and minted through the spine's sanctioned explicit-id flow (createEnvelope with an explicit spine-derived id — the W2 fixture-id and @sos-2/packages explicit-id precedent) because the hypothesis is declared BEFORE the state revision exists; the state<->graph pair is mutually consistent (state.architecture_ref === graph id AND graph.projects_system_state === state id+version), machine-verified by the exported assertRealizationRevision together with the complete-revision-chain-root check

packages/greenfield purity + determinism: the orchestrator is a pure function of its input — no I/O, no network, no hidden clocks (every instant caller-supplied, non-decreasing in pipeline order, validated), no randomness; identical input produces a byte-identical result (pinned by the property tests: randomized mission inputs -> byte-identical canonical serialization across runs, and the trace-chain fragility property: removing any chain-critical handoff link from any randomized run breaks the completeness assertion)

apps/greenfield-harness (@sos-2/greenfield-harness): a runnable end-to-end harness executing the pipeline on a golden demo scenario (a fixed package ecology: two VALIDATED member packages, one VALIDATED composition with own evidence and calibrated edge applicability, one VALIDATED durable-queue package with RETAINED failure memory, one FORMING privacy-local package; a fixed mission input; a fixed covering grant; fixed observations — deterministic: fixed inputs, fixed seed, byte-identical outputs across runs, snapshot-tested against the committed golden fixture including the trace graph) — ZERO domain logic of its own (everything imported from @sos-2/*; the import-only discipline is enforced by a static test); prints a summary report (mission -> candidate -> decision -> realization -> reconciliation -> evidence + the trace chain) and exits 0 ONLY if every stage succeeded and the trace chain is complete (the chain assertion re-verified before exit 0); no network, no time dependence (all instants fixed in the scenario)
preserved_invariants: the Semantic Spine remains the ONLY identity/envelope/kind/serialization authority: every greenfield artifact id is spine-minted; all trace links use the 17 frozen types through createTraceLink with required provenance; no second semantic registry exists (AGENTS.md section 4)

no frozen contract in spec/contracts/ was modified; spec/, docs/ and root files are untouched; sibling-owned paths (packages/brownfield, apps/brownfield-harness — W15) are untouched; all changes are additive under the two W14 owned paths

the section-10 altitude discipline is consumed, not redefined: the search runs through @sos-2/search's ladder engine (starting at VALIDATED_COMPOSITION, descending only when a rung cannot satisfy mission + constraints, every descent recorded); greenfield additionally requires the final altitude to be a validated one (VALIDATED_COMPOSITION or VALIDATED_PACKAGE) because compositions require registered validated members — descending below is a typed stage failure, never a silent fallback

the decision flow is never bypassed: the realization stage refuses an unapproved candidate (ASK without resolution, REJECT, EXPERIMENT, GATHER_EVIDENCE all leave it unapproved); the SystemState's authority_ref is the authorizing DecisionRecord id (the ACT decision, or the ask resolution on the ASK path)

compositions require their own evidence (the locked invariant): the composed candidate carries non-empty OWN assurance obligations and any cited evidence must be about the composition itself — member evidence is rejected by assertCandidateOwnEvidence; the candidate is created DISCOVERED (the sanctioned form-then-promote flow) with provisional empty evidence refs

evidence truth states pass through VERBATIM: UNAVAILABLE gaps stay UNAVAILABLE (never folded into success or zero); the availability summary reports all six states; LLM output is never evidence (no LLM is involved anywhere in the deterministic pipeline)

uncertainty is preserved end-to-end: the found composition's uncertainty class and sample size are carried onto the composed candidate's applicability estimate; no numeric confidence is invented anywhere

diversity is preserved: the search's diverse candidate set is never collapsed by the orchestrator; the Pareto ranking only orders/annotates the primary selection (a dominated candidate never becomes the primary while a non-dominated one exists); the composed candidate carries the found composition's family and dimension stances verbatim
boundary_changes: two new workspace projects: packages/greenfield (runtime deps: the thirteen orchestrated @sos-2 domain packages) and apps/greenfield-harness (runtime deps: @sos-2/greenfield + the domain packages it wires into the scenario; zero domain logic — imports only)

no new artifact kinds, no new trace-link types, no envelope changes, no schema changes; the only spine extension used is the documented explicit-id envelope flow (createEnvelope with a spine-derived id) for the declared ArchitectureGraph hypothesis

the greenfield reconciliation consumes @sos-2/conformance's reconcile as-is; the greenfield correspondence (components declaring which declared nodes they realize; the dependency graph mirroring the declared wiring) is established in the realization stage's ImplementationModel construction, not by reconfiguring the classifier
